name: SJM Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Ansan, South Korea, SJM Co., Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is primarily involved in the manufacturing and worldwide distribution of products tailored for both the automotive and industrial sectors. The company's diverse product range encompasses self-supporting and non-self-supporting items, in addition to specialized crossover joints. It operated as Sung Jin Machinery Co., Ltd. until its official rebranding to SJM Co., Ltd. in November 1996.
